zh-CN.title: AI 技能发布到skillhub By 灵途 AI
zh-CN.description: 把 AI Skill 发布到灵途 SkillHub 或腾讯 WorkBuddy（skillhub.cn）。
zh-CN.prompt: 使用 lingtu-skillhub-publish 把这个技能发布到灵途 SkillHub
highlights: 发布到灵途 SkillHub，使用独立的发布密钥
发布到腾讯 WorkBuddy 应用市场（skillhub.cn）
发布前先预览，确认后才提交
zh-CN.input: 本地 Skill 目录，以及目标平台各自的发布密钥。
zh-CN.output: 发布结果、版本号和平台回执
zh-CN.requirement: 灵途发布需要后台发布密钥；WorkBuddy 需要 skillhub.cn 的 API Key 和 CLI。其它平台接入中。

en-US.title: Publish AI Skills to SkillHub by LINGTU AI
en-US.description: Publish an AI Skill to LINGTU SkillHub or Tencent WorkBuddy (skillhub.cn).
en-US.prompt: Use lingtu-skillhub-publish to publish this skill to LINGTU SkillHub
highlights: Publish to LINGTU SkillHub with its own publisher credential
Publish to the Tencent WorkBuddy marketplace at skillhub.cn
Preview first and submit only after confirmation
en-US.input: A local Skill directory and the publisher credential for the selected platform.
en-US.output: Publish result, version, and platform receipt
en-US.requirement: LINGTU publishing needs the admin publisher credential. WorkBuddy needs a skillhub.cn API key and the CLI. Other marketplaces are not available yet.
